events.title: House of Mantra
events.description: A devotional evening orchestrated by House of Mantra, featuring world-renowned Sufi Qawwali vocalist Tahir Qawwal (25+ years, founder of Tabaruq Arts), accompanied by Alexandra Amïe, special vocalist Jamuna Luna, and Rāma on classical percussion. The programme moves through soulful Kirtans and Bhajan — ancient call-and-response devotional forms rooted in the Sufi and Hindustani traditions — designed to dissolve illusions and carry the room into collective resonance. A one-off at the Yoga Barn's main stage.
events.short_description: Sufi Qawwali vocalist Tahir Qawwal leads an evening of Kirtan and Bhajan at the Yoga Barn, joined by Alexandra Amïe, Jamuna Luna, and Rāma on classical percussion.
events.venue_address: Jalan Raya Pengosekan No. 36, Ubud, Bali
